passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD—you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders—and you are to worship at a distance.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD told Moses to come up to Him.
The LORD told Aaron to come up also.
The LORD told Nadab and Abihu to come up.
The LORD told seventy elders of Israel to come up.
The LORD commanded them to worship Him.
The LORD said they must worship from a distance.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אָמַ֜ר עֲלֵ֣ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְאַהֲרֹן֙ נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֔וּא וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים מִזִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם מֵרָחֹֽק׃

passages.text: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”
passages.sermon:
Moses is the leader of Israel.
Moses alone will approach the LORD.
The other leaders must not come near the LORD.
The people must not go up with Moses.
passages.original: וְנִגַּ֨שׁ מֹשֶׁ֤ה לְבַדּוֹ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהֵ֖ם לֹ֣א יִגָּ֑שׁוּ וְהָעָ֕ם לֹ֥א יַעֲל֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD, they all responded with one voice: “All the words that the LORD has spoken, we will do.”
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The LORD gave Moses words and laws.
Moses came to the people of Israel.
Moses told the people all the words of the LORD.
Moses told the people all the laws of the LORD.
All the people answered together.
They spoke with one voice.
They said, “We will do all the words that the LORD has spoken.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְסַפֵּ֤ר לָעָם֙ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים וַיַּ֨עַן כָּל־ הָעָ֜ם ק֤וֹל אֶחָד֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

passages.text: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain, along with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD.
He got up early the next morning.
He built an altar at the base of the mountain.
He set up twelve pillars.
Each pillar stood for one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ תַּ֣חַת הָהָ֑ר וּשְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
He sent out some young men from among the Israelites.
These young men offered burnt offerings to the LORD.
They also sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶֽת־ נַעֲרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּֽעֲל֖וּ עֹלֹ֑ת וַֽיִּזְבְּח֞וּ זְבָחִ֧ים שְׁלָמִ֛ים לַיהוָ֖ה פָּרִֽים׃

passages.text: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
He took half of the blood.
He put this half in bowls.
He took the other half of the blood.
He sprinkled this half on the altar.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ חֲצִ֣י הַדָּ֔ם וַיָּ֖שֶׂם בָּאַגָּנֹ֑ת וַחֲצִ֣י הַדָּ֔ם זָרַ֖ק עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people, who replied, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”
passages.sermon:
Moses took the Book of the Covenant.
He read the Book of the Covenant to the people of Israel.
The people listened to the words.
The people answered Moses.
They said, “We will do everything the LORD has spoken.
We will obey.”
passages.original: וַיִּקַּח֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיִּקְרָ֖א בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֥ה וְנִשְׁמָֽע׃

passages.text: So Moses took the blood, sprinkled it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses took the blood.
He sprinkled the blood on the people.
Moses spoke to the people.
He said, “This is the blood of the covenant.”
The LORD made this covenant with you.
The LORD made this covenant based on all these words.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הַדָּ֔ם וַיִּזְרֹ֖ק עַל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה דַֽם־ הַבְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם עַ֥ל כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was his brother.
Nadab and Abihu were Aaron’s sons.
Seventy elders were leaders among the people of Israel.
Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and the seventy elders went up the mountain together.
They saw the God of Israel.
Under God’s feet was something like a pavement.
This pavement looked like sapphire stone.
It was as clear as the sky.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַיִּרְא֕וּ אֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְתַ֣חַת רַגְלָ֗יו כְּמַעֲשֵׂה֙ לִבְנַ֣ת הַסַּפִּ֔יר וּכְעֶ֥צֶם הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָטֹֽהַר׃

passages.text: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank.
passages.sermon:
God did not harm the nobles of Israel.
The nobles of Israel saw God.
The nobles of Israel ate.
The nobles of Israel drank.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ אֲצִילֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֖ח יָד֑וֹ וַֽיֶּחֱזוּ֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here, so that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD told Moses to come up to Him on the mountain.
The LORD told Moses to stay there.
The LORD said He would give Moses the tablets of stone.
The LORD said these tablets have the law and the commandments.
The LORD said He wrote these for the instruction of the people.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה עֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֛י הָהָ֖רָה וֶהְיֵה־ שָׁ֑ם וְאֶתְּנָ֨ה לְךָ֜ אֶת־ לֻחֹ֣ת הָאֶ֗בֶן וְהַתּוֹרָה֙ וְהַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתַ֖בְתִּי לְהוֹרֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up on the mountain of God.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Joshua was his attendant.
Moses got up.
Joshua got up with him.
Moses went up the mountain of God.
Joshua went with him.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣קָם מֹשֶׁ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ מְשָׁרְת֑וֹ וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: And he said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we return to you. Aaron and Hur are here with you. Whoever has a dispute can go to them.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the elders.
He said, "Wait here for us.
Stay until we return to you.
Aaron is with you.
Hur is with you.
If anyone has a dispute, they should go to Aaron and Hur."
passages.original: וְאֶל־ הַזְּקֵנִ֤ים אָמַר֙ שְׁבוּ־ לָ֣נוּ בָזֶ֔ה עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־ נָשׁ֖וּב אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְחוּר֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם מִי־ בַ֥עַל דְּבָרִ֖ים יִגַּ֥שׁ אֲלֵהֶֽם׃

passages.text: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.
passages.sermon:
Moses went up on the mountain.
A cloud covered the mountain.
The glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai.
The cloud covered the mountain for six days.
On the seventh day, the LORD called to Moses from inside the cloud.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ הָהָ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־ הָהָֽר׃ וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֤ן כְּבוֹד־ יְהוָה֙ עַל־ הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַיְכַסֵּ֥הוּ הֶעָנָ֖ן שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֛ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י מִתּ֥וֹךְ הֶעָנָֽן׃

passages.text: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites saw the glory of the LORD.
They looked at the top of the mountain.
They saw something bright and powerful.
The glory of the LORD looked like a fire that burns everything.
The fire was on the mountaintop.
The Israelites saw this with their own eyes.
passages.original: וּמַרְאֵה֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה כְּאֵ֥שׁ אֹכֶ֖לֶת בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses entered the cloud.
Moses went up on the mountain.
Moses stayed on the mountain.
He remained there for forty days.
He remained there for forty nights.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הֶעָנָ֖ן וַיַּ֣עַל אֶל־ הָהָ֑ר וַיְהִ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ בָּהָ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה׃פ
